title: Email signature
slide_intent: Give a plain-text-style signature a clear reading order. Weight, color and spacing let a recipient separate the person, program and contact channels at the end of a message.
strategic_value: A compact text treatment can carry Special Olympics identity into email while keeping names and addresses easy to copy.
demonstration: A numbered specimen uses bold periods as short rules, a black name, italic title, red program line and bold channel labels. The corresponding rules specify 9 pt Arial on 12 pt spacing.
practical_value: Use Arial for this email format. Reserve the program name for program correspondence, group contact details together and set credits or accreditation in italic.

content_islands.name: Typography instructions
content_islands.spec: Use a left-hand numbered list for type settings, separators, role names, contact labels and credits.

content_islands.name: Signature specimen
content_islands.spec: Align the marked example at right with a common text edge. Separate the person and program blocks with short period rules and place the accreditation statement below the contact block.
